plan.title: Cancel Increase Event Time on Closed RFQ

steps.note: Open the prepared closed RFQ instead of creating or searching for an event.
Enable eRFX projects as required by the case.
Keep post-expiry surrogate bidding disabled for the closed RFQ.
Apply the required buyer bid-edit configuration.
Open the RFQ Responses tab where the stage Settings action is available.
Record the expected unchanged event end time before opening the dialog.
Open the Increase Event Time window and leave it unsaved so Cancel can be tested.
Cancel the Increase Event Time window.
Verify that cancelling closes the Increase Event Time window.
Verify that the event end time remains unchanged after cancellation.
